reply: {"action":"run_code","code":"const counts = new Map<string, number>(); let page = 1; let total = 0; let assigned = 0; while (page) { const result = await tools.list_issues({repo:'acme/web',state:'open',page}); for (const issue of result.items) { total++; const login = issue.assignee?.login; if (login) { assigned++; counts.set(login,(counts.get(login) ?? 0)+1); } } page = result.next_page; } const ranking = [...counts].sort(([a,x],[b,y])=>y-x || (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0)); return {total,assigned,leaders:ranking.slice(0,10)};","answer":""}
